name: Misty Reed Strand
summary: At Misty Reed Strand, the Great Sea meets the eastern edge of the Swamp of Sorrows. Crabs, crocolisks, and murlocs contest its foggy shore, where driftwood and wreckage wash ashore.

sections.title: A Foggy Shoreline
sections.body: Fog rolls in from the Great Sea along Misty Reed Strand, the eastern edge of the Swamp of Sorrows. It hides the water and dulls the cries of wildlife. Driftwood, sea debris, and rotting plants from the inland bog litter the beach. No permanent settlement holds this remote shore. Aggressive crabs forage among the debris, crocolisks stalk the water’s edge, and territorial murlocs defend their grounds.

sections.title: Contested Waters
sections.body: Neither the Alliance nor the Horde claims the beach, though scouts from both send adventurers there. Alliance parties gather driftwood and salvage while thinning the crab population. Farther inland, Horde outposts watch the murloc camps. They send fighters to curb the tribes before raiders push toward Stonard or threaten travel through the marsh.

faq.q: Where is the Misty Reed Strand located?
aliases: how to get to misty reed strand
faq.answer: Misty Reed Strand runs along the far eastern edge of the Swamp of Sorrows, beside the Great Sea. You can reach it by traveling east through the wetlands from Stonard or along the marsh paths surrounding it.

aliases: what lives on misty reed strand
faq.answer: Giant coastal crabs, swamp crocolisks, and hostile murloc tribes inhabit the shoreline, scavenging along the tide lines.

faq.q: Are there any settlements on the beach?
faq.answer: No permanent friendly town or established military outpost stands on the beach. The nearest settlements lie farther inland in the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: Why do the factions send adventurers to the Misty Reed Strand?
aliases: why go to misty reed strand
faq.answer: The Alliance sends parties to gather driftwood and coastal salvage, while Horde outposts send fighters to curb the murloc tribes along the surf.

angles.text: Alliance scouts traveling south from Nethergarde or through the marshlands scavenge driftwood and other resources on the beach. They also keep its aggressive wildlife at bay.
Stonard's defenders see the strand's murloc tribes as an unmanaged threat. They often order combat patrols to clear the encampments along the surf.
